evidence.description: CRIT-013 through CRIT-015 are binary, scoped criteria for the FIND-004/FIND-005 correction and use the authoritative safe-integer boundary values.
REQ-007 requires rounded, clamped ratios and REQ-010 requires malformed or contradictory score payloads to fail closed; the contract preserves both.
The executable boundary regression supplies numerator 945755921642804, denominator 9007199253740991, and canonical value 10; the same file retains normal-ratio and contradictory-payload coverage.
The recorded RED run isolates the float-rounding mismatch: it rejected the otherwise valid canonical safe-integer FINANCIAL model with a recomputed value of 11.
roundedScoreValue performs the shared BigInt half-up calculation and is used by measured core paths and the FINANCIAL aggregation path, with the 0..100 clamp retained.
The closed renderer imports roundedScoreValue and validates the received measured value against it after exact payload and component-ratio checks.
The correction keeps ratio computation in the pure core and presentation validation in the effectful presentation shell, matching the documented boundary.
The renderer reuses the exported core helper instead of introducing a duplicate floating-point rounding implementation.
Recorded GREEN evidence covers 14 focused score tests plus 13 UI tests, the full regression, all four deterministic eval totals, and the real PostgreSQL role/snapshot/20000-20001 contract.
The review boundary names the two governing specs, focused score/UI tests, RED/GREEN evidence, shared core, renderer, and traceability state required to judge all three criteria.
